harness_notes: No absent-export sentinel is used for translated cases. DOM adapters invoke current production functions and inspect actual rendering.
An earlier concurrent browser run used an arbitrary10second timeout and observed a late successful import; that run is excluded. Final run restores original30second timeout and serial file execution.

Source helper functionality expressed through an obsolete private function is mapped to current observable production behavior; inventory records selection by attachment ID, production offer dimensions and live DOM operations.
